remaining_boundaries: Model resistance to semantic prompt injection is not guaranteed.
Broad HTTPS host permission remains for Moodle, selected AI providers, and signed storage.
External storage was tested with fictional HTTPS redirects, not a live S3 bucket.
browser_checks: real Chromium extension loads, checks a loopback server, and verifies generation.
the local Origin workaround leaves website requests untouched.
actual Chrome action updates for a closed tab finish without unhandled promise rejections.
the options page verifies generation and restores its controls.
bundled offscreen reader extracts PDF and DOCX locally and sends image evidence.
PDF pages without a text layer are rendered locally for a vision model.
PDF pages with both text and graphics retain both kinds of evidence.
unsupported evidence is omitted without blocking the remaining correction or exposing its filename.
malformed ODT evidence stops before contacting the AI provider.
actual Chromium resolves an opaque Moodle redirect to signed HTTPS storage.
content scripts are absent from unrelated HTTPS pages.
file previews remain compact and accessible, and prominent grading status appears below the tool icons.
supervision detects the task title and describes reference files separately from submissions without downloading them.
correction reads assignment ODT references and student files locally, preserving separate roles and omitting identifying filenames and URLs.
both interfaces preview filenames with separate reference and student-work purposes before correction.
malformed popup JSON is rejected without writing it as feedback and both textareas have accessible names.
direct grading without a max attribute detects the labelled maximum and shows the mode in both interfaces.
localized maxima, unknown maxima, disabled grade fields, and grading-guide priority are detected correctly.
normal, absolute, and fixed Moodle regions fit beside the AI panel at three widths and restore on close.
invalid manual scores leave all fields untouched and valid scores still apply.
panel JSON parse, score, and repair errors appear in its status without altering Moodle fields.
technical controls are hidden by default and accessible through labelled icons with Escape and focus restoration.
instructions persist locally and synchronize between the popup and side panel, including reopening the popup.
changing students preserves course/task criteria and restores only the matching student case.
case criteria remain separate for different attempts by the same student.
student navigation clears corrections and attachments, preserves instructions, and detects the new page with the panel open.
switching students blocks stale corrections before any form field changes.
delayed AI replies are rejected after navigation and local context is not sent to AI.
a generated correction is shown as readable feedback and a proposed grade while its JSON stays behind the tool icon.
navigation during a panel request cancels the old work, restores controls, and allows a fresh correction without stale UI updates.
a changed student identity without URL navigation resets the assistant while preserving Moodle form fields.
new courses and tasks copy defaults without copying case criteria or overwriting saved task criteria.
full page navigation creates a clean assistant that detects the new page when opened.
clearing instructions persists an empty value instead of restoring previous instructions.
a deliberately cleared task criterion stays empty even when a nonempty copying default exists.
a new document copies saved course/task defaults while leaving the concrete case empty.
automatic criteria defaults stay inside their Moodle installation and do not cross into another site.
legacy instructions are retained and copied into the current task only on explicit recovery.
unsupported manual files are marked red and omitted before reading their bytes.
unsupported embedded formats are reported back in red while supported evidence continues to AI.
rubric selections require explicit identities and apply correctly even in reverse criterion order.
leaving the grader stops navigation timers/observation and returning restarts the watcher.
the settings button deletes the session API key and confirms its removal.
teacher cancellation aborts a pending provider request.
the options page can cancel its connection test.
